_readme: Hand-written additions merged on top of the extracted rules data at load time.
Use this for content the upstream data is missing — most notably the class-specific
talent trees it references but never defines (Dark Side Devotee, Force Adept, Force Item,
Sith, Expert Pilot, Gunner, Knight's Resolve, Piracy, Military Tactics).
Add the talent itself under `features`, then list its id under the tree in `talentTrees`.
A tree stops being marked incomplete as soon as it has at least one talent.
Nothing here is validated against the books — it is whatever you type.
Icons: drop a file in public/icons/features/ (or classes/, weapons/) and name it here:
Only listed icons are rendered, so a missing file can never show as a broken image.
_comment_lightsaber_chain: Saga Edition splits these talents in two. The Jedi and Jedi Knight versions are
lightsaber-only and are imported under their own ids — weapon-specialization-lightsabers
in Lightsaber Combat, greater-weapon-focus-lightsabers in Duelist. The Elite Trooper
versions in Weapon Master are the ones that choose a weapon group.
The import wired the Jedi Knight talents' prerequisites to the generic Elite Trooper ids
with a lightsabers spec, which nothing on the Jedi path ever grants — so a Jedi 7 /
Jedi Knight 5 holding the whole lightsaber chain was told it was missing Weapon
Specialization and Greater Weapon Focus. Each requirement below accepts either the
lightsaber-scoped talent or the generic one taken with lightsabers, so a Soldier or
greater-weapon-specialization-lightsabers also inherited specType/allowedSpecs from the
generic entry, so it asked for a weapon group from a list that excluded lightsabers.
Both are nulled: a lightsaber-only talent has nothing to choose.
